proof_boundary: This proves the exact Hermitian/transpose polarization of the terminal-bulk quadrature, anti-conjugate coefficient relation, observation-level coefficient completion, pure terminal Hermitian real null, pure terminal transpose determinant collapse, and its h^3 S_(1,N)^2 envelope. It proves no signed completed terminal/nonterminal estimate, complete outer-complement or quadratic residual bound, signed full-current or Phi_B theorem, contact exclusion, retained aggregate or Xi theorem, Q209, Lambda<=0, PF-infinity, RH, or prize-level conclusion.

rows.certificate: For q<N put d_q=-iu_q mathcal N_qw_q, so mathcal N_(<N,xi)=sum_(q<N)Re(d_q).
rows.claim: The nonterminal derivative is an exact finite real carrier sum.
rows.proof_boundary: No sign is inferred.

rows.certificate: Im(w_N)Re(d_q)={Im(w_Nd_q)+Im(w_Nconjugate(d_q))}/2.
rows.claim: The live terminal-bulk product has an exact two-quadrature polarization.
rows.proof_boundary: Both summands must be retained.

rows.certificate: The live kernel is sum_(q<N)Re{K_H(N,q)w_Nconjugate(w_q)+K_T(N,q)w_Nw_q}, with K_H=S_(1,N)u_qconjugate(mathcal N_q)/(4pi) and K_T=-S_(1,N)u_qmathcal N_q/(4pi).
rows.claim: One half of the live kernel is a phase-difference family.
rows.proof_boundary: It is not individually signed.

rows.certificate: The live kernel is sum_(q<N)Re{K_H(N,q)w_Nconjugate(w_q)+K_T(N,q)w_Nw_q}, with K_H=S_(1,N)u_qconjugate(mathcal N_q)/(4pi) and K_T=-S_(1,N)u_qmathcal N_q/(4pi).
rows.claim: The other half is a phase-sum family.
rows.proof_boundary: It is not individually signed.

rows.certificate: K_T(N,q)=-conjugate(K_H(N,q)); this relates coefficients but does not cancel the two distinct phase families.
rows.claim: The two coefficients are anti-conjugate.
rows.proof_boundary: Anti-conjugacy is not cancellation.

rows.certificate: Under w_q=omega_a A_q exp(-i xi u_q), w_Nconjugate(w_q)=|omega_a|^2A_NA_q exp(i xi(u_q-u_N)) is Hermitian phase-difference, while w_Nw_q=omega_a^2A_NA_q exp(-i xi(u_N+u_q)) is transpose phase-sum.
rows.claim: The two products carry distinct physical phases.
rows.proof_boundary: They cannot be identified pointwise.

rows.certificate: For mathcal N_q^0=-u_q^2/4-i u_(N,x)/2, K_H^0=-S_(1,N)u_q^3/(16pi)+iS_(1,N)u_qu_(N,x)/(8pi) and K_T^0=S_(1,N)u_q^3/(16pi)+iS_(1,N)u_qu_(N,x)/(8pi).
rows.claim: The correction-free coefficients are explicit cubic/linear functions of the logarithmic rates.
rows.proof_boundary: This does not bound corrections.

rows.certificate: The ideal real parts are opposite and the imaginary parts agree; neither coefficient has a pointwise sign.
rows.claim: Opposite real parts do not supply a joined sign.
rows.proof_boundary: The imaginary parts reinforce instead.

rows.certificate: At u_q=1, u_(N,x)=0, and w_N=w_q=i, the joined pair equals -S_(1,N)/(8pi), not zero.
rows.claim: The anti-conjugate pair is not identically zero.
rows.proof_boundary: This algebraic witness is not asserted to be a physical Xi state.

rows.certificate: For C(epsilon)=2omega_p^TJdot(epsilon)+2dot(omega_p)^TJepsilon+2epsilon^TJdot(epsilon), split epsilon=a+rho into the terminal conditional observation and every nonterminal residual observation.
rows.claim: The carrier/residual quadratic correction is one exact J-pairing.
rows.proof_boundary: The fixed terminal affine row is separate.

rows.certificate: Write epsilon=a+rho and dot epsilon=dot a+dot rho.
rows.claim: The outer observation splits into terminal conditional and nonterminal parts.
rows.proof_boundary: No source term is discarded.

rows.certificate: C(a+rho)=C(rho)+2(omega_p+rho)^TJdot a+2(dot(omega_p)+dot rho)^TJa+2a^TJdot a.
rows.claim: All mixed outer terms complete the terminal coefficient exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: This is an identity, not a bound.

rows.certificate: Put omega_*=omega_p+rho and dot(omega_*)=dot(omega_p)+dot rho. The terminal-dependent quadratic channel is Delta_a=2omega_*^TJdot a+2dot(omega_*)^TJa+2a^TJdot a.
rows.claim: The terminal-dependent channel uses complete nonterminal observations.
rows.proof_boundary: The pure terminal channel remains explicit.

rows.claim: All twelve terminal-dependent signed pairings are exposed.
rows.proof_boundary: No componentwise modulus is taken.

rows.claim: The mixed a_V coefficient is the complete nonterminal derivative row.
rows.proof_boundary: Its sign and size remain open.

rows.certificate: The affine term t_T^Tdot(epsilon) splits linearly as t_T^Tdot rho+t_T^Tdot a and is not absorbed into C or counted twice.
rows.claim: The fixed terminal affine interaction remains additive.
rows.proof_boundary: It is not hidden in the quadratic completion.

rows.certificate: For the source-inclusive conditional amplitudes A_X=tau_NP_X(log N), tau_N=kappa S_(1,N)w_N, the frequency lift is A_(dot X)=-iu_NA_X.
rows.claim: Every pure terminal S_1 observation shares one source-inclusive amplitude.
rows.proof_boundary: This concerns only the N-endpoint S_1 block.

rows.certificate: For the source-inclusive conditional amplitudes A_X=tau_NP_X(log N), tau_N=kappa S_(1,N)w_N, the frequency lift is A_(dot X)=-iu_NA_X.
rows.claim: The pure terminal derivative has one common -iu_N factor.
rows.proof_boundary: Other endpoint and interior terms are not included.

rows.certificate: H_aa=A_Vconjugate(A_(dot N))+A_Nconjugate(A_(dot V))-A_Aconjugate(A_(dot Q))-A_Qconjugate(A_(dot A)) has Re(H_aa)=0 exactly.
rows.claim: The pure terminal Hermitian current has zero real part exactly.
rows.proof_boundary: The complex Hermitian expression need not vanish.

rows.certificate: T_aa=-2iu_N(A_VA_N-A_AA_Q).
rows.claim: The pure terminal transpose current is one carrier determinant.
rows.proof_boundary: It can have either sign after projection.

rows.certificate: The carrier identities A_N=R_NC_N and mathcal N_N=R_NQ_N+R_(N,x)C_N give C_Nmathcal N_N-A_NQ_N=R_(N,x)C_N^2 exactly.
rows.claim: The determinant collapses to the terminal x-rate.
rows.proof_boundary: No approximate cancellation is used.

rows.certificate: Hence T_aa=-2iu_N tau_N^2 R_(N,x)C_N^2, and the actual pure-terminal real current is R_aa=(1/2)Re(T_aa).
rows.claim: The complete pure S_1-by-S_1 current is an h-cubed transpose remainder.
rows.proof_boundary: This is not the mixed terminal-bulk term.

rows.certificate: The physical terminal boxes give u_N<2h, |R_(N,x)|<h^2/20, |C_N|<3/2, and |kappa|^2=1/(4pi^2)<1/36 because pi>3. The source-inclusive pure conditional quadratic obeys |R_aa|<h^3 S_(1,N)^2 |w_N|^2/160.
rows.claim: The pure terminal real current has an explicit source-relative envelope.
rows.proof_boundary: The source amplitude is not numerically bounded here.

rows.certificate: This is h^3 times a squared logarithmic kernel, whereas the mixed terminal-bulk channel is linear in S_(1,N) and contains the complete nonterminal derivative observation; no cancellation follows from scale alone.
rows.claim: The pure terminal block cannot furnish the missing order-one algebraic cancellation.
rows.proof_boundary: A signed mixed estimate is still required.

rows.certificate: Expand rho into the lower S_1 endpoint, the S_2/S_3 endpoints, and the absolutely convergent interior; then form the completed Hermitian and transpose kernels for dot N_*a_V before taking moduli.
rows.claim: Prove or falsify the completed terminal/nonterminal Hermitian-transpose estimate.
rows.proof_boundary: No signed completed bound is proved.

rows.certificate: The factor 1/(4pi) is one half of the Section 11.184 factor 1/(2pi), and |kappa|=1/(2pi); no geometric fitting is introduced.
rows.claim: Every pi factor is inherited from Fourier normalization.
rows.proof_boundary: No circle or polygon supplies pi.

rows.claim: The phase completion preserves every outer and moved-tail channel.
rows.proof_boundary: The lower endpoint, S_2/S_3 terms, interior, correction, and moved-tail defect remain open obligations.

rows.proof_boundary: This is not a proof of RH.
